adopt_native_verdict.deciding_evidence: AnyTool §5.2: 16k API schemas do not fit in a 128k window, so native all-in-context is impossible at that size. ToolkenGPT §4.2: ICL collapses above 30 tools. ToolLLM Table 3: a trained retriever is required to rank 16,464 APIs (NDCG@1 84.2 vs BM25 18.4). No paper reports native-PD selection accuracy at any catalog size, so the inherited grade cannot be promoted from published measurements.
adopt_native_verdict.settling_comparison: RES-0101: on THIS estate's live tool inventory, publish a gold routing task set first, then measure native progressive-disclosure (all name+description in context) versus a retrieval router versus a learned router at >=3 catalog sizes, with a control task that must stay correct at every size.
adopt_native_verdict.strongest_caveat: This estate's live skill/tool count is not measured here (that is RES-0101). If the live catalog is <<30, native PD may still win on cost; the published record only refutes treating adopt-native as settled for large catalogs.
adopt_native_verdict.target: adopt native progressive disclosure; reject a bespoke retriever (WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json RES-0100 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM-AND-FRONTIER-RESEARCH.md:83-84,100). The named 05-ECO file is absent from this Linux worktree.
adopt_native_verdict.what_is_refuted: The inherited grade as an unconditional, size-independent instruction to adopt native progressive disclosure and reject a bespoke retriever.
adopt_native_verdict.what_survives: Native PD remains a reasonable default at small catalogs (ToolkenGPT shows in-context still works near 13-30 tools; API-Bank Call at 73 is 63.66% when the API is given). It is unmeasured on this estate.
